description: Intracranial recordings from 176 sites in ten epileptic patients viewing masked and unmasked words (Gaillard et al. 2009, reported by Dehaene and Changeux) found four signatures of conscious perception: late distributed ERPs reaching prefrontal cortex, late high-gamma power, long-distance beta synchrony, and increased causal relations between distant areas.

sources.quote: Four objective signatures of conscious perception were identified (Figure 3)
